text:
ana: Hey support — ACME flagged that their daily CSV export for 2026-01-12 contains a few 'orphaned' rows and the dashboard shows 0 tokens for that day. they say invoice still charged. attaching export path: s3://redwood-exports/acme/2026-01-12/usage.csv
ingest-bot: [alert] usage-aggregator v3 job 34821 failed to complete on 2026-01-13T03:12Z (shard=7, reason=timeout) :warning:
chen: Thanks, looking. can you paste 2-3 example rows from the CSV?
nana: (typo) ana: sure, here's a redacted snippet:
```
session_id,customer_id,timestamp,model,tokens
sess_8a7f,acme,2026-01-12T09:02:12Z,gpt-redwood-3b,0
sess_f1c2,acme,2026-01-12T14:21:07Z,gpt-redwood-3b,0
sess_99b0,acme,2026-01-12T18:45:33Z,gpt-redwood-3b,0
```
mike: those look like the 'prefetch' rows where tokens aren't attributed because aggregator hit a race with prefix-cache backfill. not identical to previous export issues but related. any ingest errors in logs?
emma: I pulled the job trace: aggregator retried shard 7 3x, then timed out. downstream step "token-attribution" skipped when cache_miss_count > 1000.
chen: root cause hypothesis: nightly backfill process started while shard compaction was running, resulting in duplicate row inserts with token=0 later deduped in DB but not in CSV generator. CSV generator reads raw export table which includes temporary rows.
jess (billing): Customer is asking why invoice shows charges if dashboard tokens are 0 for that day. we need a quick reconciliation to tell them which tokens were billed.
nana: ana: quick repro I ran locally: run the export generator against the raw export table at commit X, and you'll see the orphaned rows. command I used:
```
EXPORT_SOURCE=http://internal-api/export/raw?shard=7&date=2026-01-12
curl -s "$EXPORT_SOURCE" | head -n 50
```
mike: good repro. short term workaround: re-run post-processor that filters rows where tokens==0 and session_state=="completed" and regenerate the CSV. i'll spin a job.
chen: I'll also schedule a targeted backfill that recomputes token attribution for 2026-01-12 for shard 7. ETA ~2h due to volume.
emma: ops note: the aggregator service should treat backfill windows as exclusive from compaction; I'll add a mutex and a healthcheck gating.
jess (billing): For ACME response: propose we (1) provide corrected CSV, (2) show reconciled token counts and a bill-credit if necessary, (3) explain root cause and mitigation. can we commit to timeline?
mike: regenerate CSV now -> 1839994400, backfill job starts 1839994600, finish ETA 2h -> update when done.
nana: ana: shared the temp corrected CSV to s3://redwood-support-temp/acme/2026-01-12/corrected.csv and DM'ed customer. cc @jess (billing)
chen: follow-up: job logs show 12k rows flagged as orphaned; after recompute we attribute ~135k tokens. that matches charge on invoice.
jess (billing): ok, will explain to ACME: invoice is correct because some usage was eventually attributed by backfill; the initial CSV/Dashboard showed zeros due to incomplete aggregation. offering a goodwill credit? pending approval.
emma: created issue INF-1428 to add mutex and add additional retries with adaptive backoff.
mike: done regenerating CSV and kicked off backfill (job 34900). monitoring. :white_check_mark:
nana: thanks all. I'll mark the thread for follow-up once job completes and billing has sent customer message.
ingest-bot: job 34900 started at 2026-01-13T04:12Z (initiated by mike)
